page.content:
Municipal body that may be five, or one, or lizards in robes.

How Night Vale City Council connects

  • Location: Night Vale — The City Council issues the edicts that govern Night Vale.
  • Faction: angels — The City Council forbids both the angels and the word angel.
  • Concept: the Glow Cloud — The Glow Cloud holds a seat on the Night Vale City Council.

What is Night Vale City Council?

The Night Vale City Council issues the day's bans — the dog park, the angels, the talking about the Glow Cloud — from a dais that is not always the same number of people.

Key threads lead to Night Vale, angels and the Glow Cloud.
